SEASON

When this trip makes sense.

A reliable month-by-month fishing window has not been established from the inspected material for this particular trip. Ask the local operator or fisheries service to confirm the target, access and conditions for your dates before making non-refundable arrangements.

The decision that shapes this trip

Book by the skill you want to learn and the water used for that lesson. Ask what tackle is included and which method the instructor will teach. A first lesson should not require buying an entire fly or coarse-fishing setup in advance.

Choose a reach and presentation

A river name is not a complete day plan. Decide the reach, bank access and presentation first. Ask for the useful lure weight or fly-line arrangement, then match the rod, reel and leader to that answer. Wading is a separate decision and is not assumed in this brief.

LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for Belgium

Freshwater permits differ between Flanders, Wallonia and Brussels. In Wallonia, most rivers outside the public navigable waterways also require a club card or the fishing-right holder's permission.

  • 14 consecutive daysWallonia short-stay permit
Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Permits for this trip

  • Local fishing society card ↗
    Anglers on privately controlled Ourthe reaches or tributaries where a club holds the fishing rights. Obtain the card from the society for the exact river reach.
